response.sql: WITH site_ratio AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS mesh_cnt FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), site_cmp AS (SELECT zoneregistry, insurstat, ratio, mesh_cnt, AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY insurstat) AS status_avg FROM site_ratio WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT insurstat, AVG(ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, SUM(mesh_cnt) AS total_mesh_records, AVG(ratio - status_avg) AS avg_excess FROM site_cmp WHERE ratio > status_avg GROUP BY insurstat

assumptions.assumption: A zero geomdeltamm gives a missing ratio (NULLIF), so it is ignored like a NULL value.
A site's mesh record count is the count of all its mesh records, including records whose ratio is missing.
Sites whose ratios are all missing are left out of the status average and cannot be kept.
Only NULL insurstat counts as no recorded insurance status.
